[[File:Gundark_1.jpg|thumb|right|A ''Nyubba''-class cargo barge driver with three cargo barges mounted to the fore of its central section.]]
The [[Nyubba-class cargo barge driver|''Nyubba''-class cargo barge driver]] employed specialized '''cargo barges''' to supplement its carrying capacity. Attached to the fore and aft of the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] central section, the cargo barges increased the cargo space of a typical ''Nyubba''-class vessel. The ''[[Chubby Gundark]]'' held the record for transporting the most barge with an uncontrolled landing; a total of thirteen barges over thirty-five [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]].
